title: Red. White. Blue.Three peacocks. One magnificent dance of nature.#youtubeshorts #brainandmindgym
description:
When nature spreads its colours, it becomes a celebration of beauty and harmony.
These three peacocks — red, white, and blue — remind us that diversity does not divide beauty; it multiplies it.
Like their feathers, life becomes most magnificent when every colour finds its place.
